title: Public submission accepts a fabricated questionnaire snapshot
launch_impact: Blocks launch
verification: Runtime reproduced against the real validateDraft
affected: Questionnaire fidelity, reviewer evidence, held data
remediation: Ship a canonical server-side bank; rebuild source text, timeframe, status, reviewStatus and disposition from it; reject unknown IDs, mismatches, held rows and stale acknowledgements.
acceptance_test: Forged MED-11, INVENTED-99, changed-timeframe and zero-answer payloads return 422 and write no row.

title: Consent evidence is client-asserted and not validated against server policy
launch_impact: Blocks launch; independently blocks enabling marketing
classification: Confirmed defect; marketing part is a pre-enable gate
verification: Runtime reproduced against the real validateDraft
affected: Consent separation, TCPA evidence, privacy acknowledgement
remediation: Use server constants for consent IDs, versions and wording hashes; a server-owned channel/seller policy; reject duplicates, unknown IDs, mismatches and future timestamps; store client and server receipt times separately.
acceptance_test: Forged marketing while disabled, wrong version/text, duplicate/unknown ID and future timestamps return 422; a valid draft returns 201 with both times.

title: The questionnaire replaces seven source windows and has no source-verified row
launch_impact: Blocks launch; primary blocker
classification: Confirmed deviation plus missing named approval
verification: Recomputed from the audited bank and reconciliation data
remediation: Obtain a named owner/counsel/underwriting decision for each of the 37 rows; restore the source window or record an approved deviation with name/date; set sourceVerified only then; bump the version and regenerate the report.
acceptance_test: A signed table covers all 37 rows; check:bank passes; branch tests cover restored rows; sourceVerified is true only with evidence.

title: Client-supplied crisis flag and review flags are not re-derived server-side
launch_impact: Blocks launch
verification: Runtime reproduced against the real validateDraft; portal path statically traced
affected: Current-crisis triage, reviewer safety, queue prioritisation
remediation: Derive crisisDisclosure from the canonical MH-05 answer on the server; derive flags from the answer set; ignore or reject client flags that contradict answers; test MH-05 Yes with false flags.
acceptance_test: A payload with MH-05 Yes and crisisDisclosure:false is either rejected or stored with crisis_disclosure true and an urgent server-derived flag; no client-supplied flag can remove it.

title: Branch-closed details survive into the submitted record
launch_impact: Blocks launch for the answer-integrity gate
verification: Runtime reproduced with the real engine
affected: Answer integrity, branch behaviour, reviewer view
remediation: Delete hidden descendants when visibility changes; omit fields/details for not_asked; render no components for not-asked rows; test nested branches.
acceptance_test: Parent flip leaves no hidden child fields in state, payload or portal.

title: No submission idempotency; ambiguous retries duplicate cases
launch_impact: Blocks launch for the delivery-reliability gate
verification: Statically demonstrated; no HTTP load test
remediation: Per-draft idempotency key, unique index, replay returns the original receipt, abortable client request reusing the key.
acceptance_test: Concurrent and timed-out submissions create exactly one case with one reference.

title: Notification retry can duplicate sends and has no row claiming
launch_impact: Blocks launch for the delivery-reliability gate
verification: Statically demonstrated
remediation: Provider idempotency key, row lease/SKIP LOCKED, sending state before call, message-ID reconciliation, persisted receipt.
acceptance_test: Crash-after-accept and overlapping-worker tests produce exactly one email.

title: Delivery webhook accepts replay/out-of-order events and can regress status
launch_impact: Blocks launch for the delivery-evidence gate
verification: Statically demonstrated
remediation: Verify provider signature over raw body, timestamp tolerance, event-ID dedupe, no downgrade from delivered, message-ID reconciliation.
acceptance_test: Forged, replayed and out-of-order events cannot create or regress delivery evidence.

title: Deployment configuration and retry schedule are absent from the repository
launch_impact: Blocks deployment and launch
verification: Repository inspection
evidence: README.md:222-234; LOVABLE.md; no supabase/config.toml; no cron definition
remediation: Commit the three function JWT settings and a documented schedule; verify a deployed 401-to-201 transition and one cron tick.
acceptance_test: A clean deployment accepts an anonymous non-customer submission and the retry worker runs on schedule.

title: No adult/self or jurisdiction verification
launch_impact: Blocks launch unless the business accepts the risk in writing
verification: Static; runtime probe accepted a ZZ state
remediation: Capture DOB/adult attestation before health questions; compute age server-side; validate state against the US list; reject non-self; test 17-year-old, ZZ and third-party payloads.
acceptance_test: A 17-year-old, ZZ state and non-self relationship are rejected.

title: Held sensitive source questions are shown verbatim to customers
launch_impact: Blocks launch for the sensitive-question gate
verification: Statically demonstrated in the review component
remediation: Show a count and generic topics or internal references, not source text; keep the full list in the reviewer/coverage record; test the customer DOM.
acceptance_test: Held wording is absent from the customer DOM and public bundle under the chosen policy.

title: Marketing revocation and suppression are promised but unimplemented
launch_impact: Pre-enable gate; blocks enabling marketing, not the current disabled-channel build
verification: Static; no outbound marketing channel is enabled
affected: Consent withdrawal, suppression enforcement, TCPA operations
evidence: src/pages/MessagingTermsPage.tsx:37-42; supabase/migrations/0001_pre_underwriting.sql:199-224; grep finds no application read of contact_suppressions
remediation: Add a revocation path and operator procedure; check suppression before every outbound attempt; log receipt and action; test STOP, email withdrawal and a revoked number.
acceptance_test: A revocation creates a suppression record and an outbound attempt is blocked with auditable timing.

title: Reviewer MFA is enrollment-only; no policy requires an AAL2 session
launch_impact: Blocks launch for real customer data
verification: Statically demonstrated; live session behaviour not tested
remediation: Require aal2 in the reviewer RLS policies or a trusted gateway, and make the portal refuse an aal1 session with a clear step-up prompt; test with a password-only session.
acceptance_test: A password-only reviewer session sees zero cases and cannot call the review/correction RPCs; after TOTP step-up the same session succeeds.

title: No retention, deletion, backup or incident-response control is implemented
launch_impact: Blocks launch for real customer data
verification: Repository inspection; no live project available
affected: Data lifecycle, deletion requests, breach readiness
remediation: Approve a retention schedule; add a controlled deletion/expiry procedure and audit entry; document backup expiry and incident response; test a labelled case deletion and restore path.
acceptance_test: A labelled case can be deleted under the approved procedure, the deletion is audited, backups expire on schedule and the incident runbook names an owner and contact path.

title: Privacy acknowledgement records the wrong notice version
launch_impact: Nonblocking independently; fix with QW-02
verification: Statically demonstrated
remediation: Use a per-purpose noticeVersion and stamp the privacy record with PRIVACY_PRACTICES_VERSION.
acceptance_test: The stored privacy record carries the displayed privacy version.

title: Body cap counts characters, not bytes
launch_impact: Nonblocking hardening
verification: Runtime reproduced with the real handler
remediation: Measure TextEncoder byte length or stream with a byte counter; reject before full buffering where possible.
acceptance_test: A multibyte body above 512 KiB returns 413 before validation or service configuration.

title: Rate limiting is per-instance and keyed by a spoofable header
launch_impact: Nonblocking at low volume with monitoring; relevant before public launch
verification: Statically demonstrated
remediation: Durable or WAF limiting keyed on trustworthy client identity; alert on submission volume.
acceptance_test: Header rotation and a second instance do not bypass the durable limit.

title: not_sent cases are never retried
launch_impact: Nonblocking only if no real case is submitted before provider configuration; otherwise operational blocker
verification: Statically demonstrated
remediation: Add an operator re-notify action for not_sent, or include it once a provider is configured, with an audit entry.
acceptance_test: A not_sent case can be re-queued and produces exactly one notification.

title: Confirmation says the case was queued when notification was not sent
launch_impact: Nonblocking; fix before launch
verification: Statically traced in the not_sent path
remediation: Make the header conditional on notification state; say saved but not sent and give the next step; test preview/not_sent.
acceptance_test: No 'queued' copy appears unless state is queued/accepted, and the header matches the timeline.

title: Stale and misleading documentation and UI counts
launch_impact: Nonblocking; fix before launch
verification: Recomputed from the audited files
remediation: Generate counts from one source; relabel 76 as approved core rows or show 113/85; remove 56; implement or remove Not applicable; replace inherited walkthrough numbers with a dated ledger.
acceptance_test: A generated count check passes and no stale count remains in customer or reviewer copy.

title: Dependency and CI supply-chain exposure
launch_impact: Nonblocking
verification: npm audit and workflow inspection
remediation: Update Vite/react-router to patched releases, pin actions to SHAs, consider npm ci --ignore-scripts, review install scripts.
acceptance_test: No high advisory remains and CI actions are SHA-pinned.

title: Deno dependencies are unpinned and there is no lockfile
launch_impact: Nonblocking
verification: Repository inspection
remediation: Pin exact versions, commit deno.lock and run tests with the lockfile in CI.
acceptance_test: A clean CI run uses the committed lockfile and pinned versions.

title: Live portal never records an 'opened' access entry
launch_impact: Nonblocking; fix with access logging
verification: Statically demonstrated
remediation: Record one opened entry per reviewer/case load (idempotent per session) through the RPC, and show it in the review log; test deduplication and failure handling.
acceptance_test: Loading a case as a reviewer adds one opened entry with actor and time; reload does not spam duplicates.

title: Immutability trigger covers the payload but not all evidence metadata
launch_impact: Nonblocking hardening
classification: Confirmed narrow scope; no reviewer exploit
verification: Isolated PostgreSQL replay
remediation: Include derived evidence columns in the immutable set, or document why they are mutable; test with the service role.
acceptance_test: A service-role change to crisis_disclosure or residence_state is rejected or explicitly audited.
